alarm.none: No alarms yet — add one, pick a threshold and how long it must hold.
app.title: SuperCam — live
btn.camera.title: Camera network settings
cam.name: Name
cam.notAccepted: the camera did not accept the change
cam.note: Saving writes the settings to the camera. They only take hold after a reboot — use Reboot camera below.
cam.rebootConfirm:
Reboot the camera now?

It drops off the network for around 30 seconds, comes back on its stored address, and this relay reconnects by itself.
cam.rebootSent: Reboot sent — the camera restarts and the view returns shortly.
cam.saved: Saved — the camera now holds {ip}. Reboot it for this to take hold.
cam.sub: Read and written directly to the camera over its control port.
cam.timeout: Timed out waiting for the camera (12s).
cam.title: Camera network settings
cam.writeConfirm:
Write {ip} to the camera?

The camera reboots and the live view will drop for ~30s.
clips.none: Nothing saved yet — a clip is kept automatically when an alarm fires.
feed.codec.title: visible feed: decoded in this browser (no transcoding on the relay)
feed.mjpeg.title: visible feed: MJPEG from the relay — {why}
measure.hint: Choose Point or Box, then click the image. The radio marks the reference for the delta column.
note.text: Visible 1280×720 + thermal 160×120, both live streams. Wipe is the default view; the thermal never moves — calibration adjusts the video layer.
ref.none: No reference frame — press Set reference with a board in view.
ref.pickTwo: Pick two different references to compare.
snap.none: No snapshots yet — the button above saves one here with its raw frame.
tcal.hint: Measure a reference of known temperature with a point or box, enter its true temperature, then repeat with a second reference well away from it. The readings become (raw × scale) + offset.
update.confirm:
Update to {to}?

The relay downloads that release, keeps a backup of the current one, then restarts itself.
update.failed.title: the relay did not come back on a new version
why.insecure: WebCodecs needs a secure context — open this over https
